Hi Liam & Priya —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call + the items we promised to surface for your procurement and finance teams. I want to make sure we capture the right approvers and any gating docs so your onboarding window stays on track.

Key takeaways (from NovaPlus side):
- Decision committee: Dana Reeves (CFO) + Priya (Head of Product) + Liam (CTO) will give final signoff.
- Security: small open items on network egress and data retention (you mentioned a standard vendor security pack).
- Procurement: you use a PO-first flow for new vendors; estimated procurement lead time ~2–3 weeks once legal/finance have signoff.

Action items we agreed on:
1) We will send a vendor intake form and a short SOW outline you can attach to the PO (Evelyn) — attached.
2) Procurement will confirm whether a standard vendor questionnaire (security evidence) is required before PO (Liam to confirm).
3) Align on invoice remit and billing cadence (monthly in arrears vs. upfront credits) — Jonas from finance is on standby to confirm options.

Next step: can you confirm the primary procurement contact and whether you require a W-9/Tax form or any marketplace purchase order reference?

I'll follow up with a short checklist for your billing/procurement team.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Evelyn —

Appreciate the concise recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement contact is procurement@novaplus.com (cc'd). They will want the vendor intake + SOW to validate spend category.
2) We do generally require the security questionnaire before issuing a PO — however, for smaller pilots we can route a provisional PO if legal signs an SOW addendum.
3) Dana (CFO) will want a one-pager with expected monthly spend ranges so finance can prep a short memo.

I can pull Dana in if you prefer; otherwise Priya will surface this to the committee next Tuesday.

Hi procurement team / Priya / Liam —

Looping in our finance lead (Jonas) and solutions engineer (Karthik) so we can surface the right docs. Attached is the vendor intake form and the SOW outline — both intentionally condensed to match a pilot purchase.

What we need from procurement to create a PO-ready package:
- Confirm remit name and billing address for the PO.
- Confirm whether you require redwood's tax forms (we can provide a W-9 / EIN immediately).
- Confirm PO reference format (e.g., PO-2026-#### or marketplace reference).

Jonas will propose two billing cadences: monthly invoicing or monthly usage credit applied against a prepaid balance. We typically see customers pick monthly invoicing for pilots under $25k.

If helpful, I can prepare a one-page spend estimate for Dana (quick table with low/likely/high monthly spend). Would you like that as a PDF or just in the body of an email?

Thanks,
Evelyn

Thanks for the attachments. Quick answers from procurement:
- Remit name: NovaPlus, Inc.; billing address: 120 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105.
